def test_manytomanyfield__get_m2m_attr():

    def test_get_m2m_attr():
        class Author(models.Model):
            name = models.CharField(max_length=100)

        class Book(models.Model):
            title = models.CharField(max_length=100)
            authors = models.ManyToManyField(Author, through='BookAuthor')

        class BookAuthor(models.Model):
            book = models.ForeignKey(Book, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
            author = models.ForeignKey(Author, on_delete=models.CASCADE)
            order = models.PositiveIntegerField()

        book = Book(title="The Great Gatsby")
        author = Author(name="F. Scott Fitzgerald")

        book_author = BookAuthor(book=book, author=author, order=1)
        book_author.save()

        book_authors = book.authors.all()
        assert len(book_authors) == 1
        assert book_authors[0].author.name == "F. Scott Fitzgerald"

        book_authors = book.authors.filter(order=1)
        assert len(book_authors) == 1
        assert book_authors[0].author.name == "F. Scott Fitzgerald"

        book_authors = book.authors.filter(order=2)
        assert len(book_authors) == 0
